name: Quant Analysis Agent
description: Computes quantitative risk metrics, financial analysis, behavioral signals, and peer comparisons using yfinance and LangGraph

skills.name: Quantitative Analysis
skills.description: Compute Sharpe ratio, Beta, VaR, volatility, DCF valuation, stress tests, Monte Carlo simulation, and portfolio correlation
examples: Run a DCF valuation on AAPL
Stress test MSFT under different market scenarios

skills.name: Options Flow Analysis
skills.description: Analyze put/call volume ratio, open interest imbalance, and unusual options activity to gauge market positioning and sentiment
examples: What's the options flow on NVDA?
Is there unusual options activity in AAPL?
Show me the put/call ratio for TSLA

skills.name: Insider Transaction Analysis
skills.description: Parse SEC Form 4 filings to detect insider buying and selling patterns, cluster activity, CEO/CFO transactions, and net insider direction over the past 90 days
examples: Show me recent insider transactions for MSFT
Is there a cluster of insider selling at NVDA?

skills.name: Positioning & Analyst Signals
skills.description: Aggregate analyst consensus ratings, price target upside, short interest ratio, and earnings surprise history into a composite positioning signal
examples: What is analyst consensus on TSLA?
What is the short interest on NVDA?
Has AAPL been consistently beating earnings estimates?
